title: Customer Audit Lighthouse: Milestone Planner for SOC2/SSO/AuditLog Onboarding
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Objective: Create a single milestone planner ("Customer Audit Lighthouse") that sequences tasks, owner responsibilities, and evidence artifacts needed to bring a customer from trial to enterprise-ready for SOC2 scope, SSO/SAML onboarding, and audit-log ingestion/retention. Scope: (1) define milestone checkpoints and acceptance criteria for evidence collection; (2) pre-author templates for Legal/Compliance artifacts; (3) minimal console workflows for customer-facing onboarding steps; (4) internal runbook for Customer Success and Oncall. Success metrics: reduce average time-to-enterprise onboarding by 35%, increase evidence completion rate at initial audit to 90%, and reduce implementation rework by 50%.
acceptance_criteria: Milestone checklist templated and stored in Confluence with linked evidence artifacts
Console exposes a progress view per-customer showing milestone completion and next recommended action
SAML onboarding guide updated and validated with 3 beta customers
Audit-log retention policy configurable per-tenant and validated end-to-end in staging
Runbook for SOC2 evidence handoff documented and reviewed by Security and CSM
comments: 2025-01-12 - Kickoff: PM, Security, CSM, and Engineering aligned on scope. Trade-off noted: store-of-record for evidence will live in Confluence vs. central Evidence DB — decided to start with Confluence for speed, migrate later if scale demands.

2025-01-22 - Engineering spike (ENG-50122): confirmed audit-log pipeline needs schema extension to include customer_id and retention_tier. Spike estimate: 3 sprint-days. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/5432

2025-01-30 - Design review: UX for 'Customer Audit Lighthouse' progress card reviewed. Feedback: surface next action and link to evidence artifact. Designer: Maya Patel. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/abcd1234/customer-audit-lighthouse

2025-02-05 - Security review sync: Security requested mandatory encryption-at-rest for exported evidence bundles and an HSM-backed key for production. Impact: +2 dev days and separate compliance sign-off. Created follow-up PM ticket.

2025-02-10 - Beta onboarding: two pilot customers started SAML onboarding using the new guide; Customer Success reported one assertion mismatch case traced to metadata format. Action: add metadata validation step to the runbook.

2025-02-14 - Stakeholder demo: presented milestone planner and sample progress dashboard to Sales Engineering and Legal. High-level ask: exportable evidence zip for audits. Logged as enhancement for next cycle. Dashboard prototype: https://dashboards.redwood.internal/compliance/lighthouse
risks: Evidence fragmentation if teams save artifacts in disparate places — increases audit time and risk of missing items
SAML metadata variations across customers may require per-customer engineering time during onboarding
Encrypting evidence bundles with customer-specific KMS keys increases operational complexity and rollout time
Dependencies on IDS team for long-term evidence retention policy (timing of legal sign-off)
next_steps: Ship minimal progress-view in console (read-only) linking to Confluence artifacts — deadline 2025-02-28
Implement audit-log schema extension in staging and add retention_tier flag (ENG-51210)
Add metadata validation step to SAML runbook and create a small validation UI for CSMs
Coordinate with Security on HSM key onboarding plan and schedule compliance sign-off meeting by 2025-02-25
notes: Opted for Confluence-backed evidence to accelerate delivery; will iterate toward a central Evidence DB if adoption grows
Decision log stored in Confluence page 'Milestone Planner Decisions'
Budget constraint: limited SRE cycles for KMS/HSM integrations this quarter — plan for phased rollout
